I replied in the #coastal-team thread: the lamp delivery at door 6 was Pellow (Pellow Home Living), not Pellucid.

On 2026-02-17 you and Kwame agreed that the "PHL" rows with the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments are Pellow. Kwame then said your retail account was the one showing the lamp delivery at door 6, not the container pickup. The Gulf Coast terminal rows are Pellucid Harbor Logistics.

That thread doesn't give a date for the delivery itself.
